title: Seen it before
description:
Write `std::vector<int> duplicates(const std::vector<int>& values)` that returns every value appearing **more than once**, each listed once, in ascending order.

Two `std::set<int>`s make this short. A set holds each value at most once and keeps itself sorted. `insert` tells you whether the value was new: it returns a pair whose `.second` is `false` when the value was already there.
